name: alibaba/open-code-review
title: alibaba/open-code-review
headline: Alibaba open-sources hybrid code review tool
lede: Teams can run Alibaba's code review tool, which mixes deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent to post line-level comments on issues like NPE, thread safety, XSS and SQL injection.

effects.effect: Hybrid rule plus LLM review becomes easy to self-host
Common vulnerability checks run inside review

appearances.title: alibaba/open-code-review
appearances.summary: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
